subject.title: fix(discord): surface failed bulk reaction removals instead of false success

question: Should maintainers require live Discord proof for the failed bulk reaction-delete path, or explicitly override the proof gate for this bounded fix?
rationale: The source fix is narrow and well placed, but the contributor evidence still substitutes the Discord network peer, so ClawSweeper cannot treat the real behavior proof gate as satisfied without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require live Discord proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Discord output, runtime logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing a failed bulk reaction delete no longer reports success before merge.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly own the proof gap if the source-level path and injected-fetch harness are enough for this bounded Discord bug fix.

options.title: Keep paused
options.body: Leave the PR open but blocked until acceptable proof is added, since the code change remains useful.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Discord output, runtime logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing a failed bulk reaction delete no longer reports success before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current affected helper and adjacent caller are currently blamed to recent Discord file restoration work under this account, with older Discord reaction helper history also tied to the same area.
